_README: Bundled stock passages for the Learn 'sight-read' source (Epic 6a, issue #71 / 6a-3). Loaded VERBATIM by both apps (iOS from the app bundle, Android from copied assets) so the list is identical across platforms. This is shared CONTENT, not a frozen behavioural contract -- but it lives in shared/ for the same reason the contracts do: both platforms must show the same passages. Each 'text' is authored already-clean: sanitize(text) == text (see shared/source_contract.json). The SanitizeParity tests AND shared/tools/gen_sanitize_vectors.py both assert that, so a passage edited to include punctuation/lowercase/double-spaces fails before it can ship silently mangled. 'hint' is a content-neutral teaser shown in the picker; the passage text is NEVER shown there (the drill HUD reveals one target at a time -- that is what 'sight-read' means). The tests assert the sanitised hint does not contain the passage text.

_format.id: Stable kebab-case ASCII identifier, unique across the list.
_format.hint: Short content-neutral label shown in the sight-read picker. Must not reveal the passage text.
_format.text: The drill passage, authored already-clean (sanitize(text) == text), non-empty, within source_contract.max_targets.
